title: Evaluation of the Role of Follicular Sensitivity Index in the Prediction of IVF/ICSI Outcome
brief_summary: Records of women who had in vitro fertilization (IVF) or intra-cytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) in Dar AlTeb sub-fertility center will be reviewed and the follicular sensitivity index (FSI) will be calculated and correlated with pregnancy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* IVF/ICSI

Exclusion Criteria:

* Missing data
* Cancelled cycles.
* Polycystic ovarian syndrome.
study_population: The records of women who had IVF/ICSI without PCO will be reviewed to calculate the FSI.
